# CSH Vault Consulting

> Operator-led development, real-estate, and capital-strategy advisory. Publisher of the Terafab Corridor report.

## About
CSH Vault Consulting is an independent advisory practice founded by Russ Michaels (legal name Russ Michael Schmidtberger). It advises on development, asset decisions, and capital strategy: whether to build, buy, hold, sell, restructure, or walk away.

Contact: (888) 833-2510 · russ@csh-vault.com · https://www.csh-vault.com
